proposal.text:
Hi Shan,

I see you’re looking to extract complete, accurate business data from BBB.org across niches like dentists, med spas, gyms, and more. That’s exactly the kind of large-scale web scraping I can help with.

With my background in Selenium automation (along with Python and proxies for scale), I’ve handled projects that required pulling thousands of records while avoiding blocking issues. I can capture every detail you listed—business info, contact details, BBB ratings, reviews, years in business, social links—and deliver it in a clean, structured Excel or Google Sheet.

For quality assurance, I suggest starting with a sample dataset from one niche/location. That way, you can review formatting and accuracy before I move on to the full scrape.

Would you like me to prepare a quick sample from BBB.org so you can see the output structure?

Best regards,
Adiel
